name: Scrap wire
description: Bits of copper. Doc Perrin pays for it.

name: Pirate radio
description: Illegal to own. An audit will find it.

name: Fuse kit
description: Spare fuses for the power grid.

name: Noise-maker
description: A clockwork rattle. Throw it and robots go to see what made the noise.

name: Wire cutters
description: Cuts a camera's cable. The city will send someone to fix it.

name: Stun charge
description: Knocks the nearest robot in reach offline for a while. It is a fight: the alert rises, the robot calls for help, and you lose credits in the scuffle.

name: Slug round
description: Destroys a robot, loudly. The whole city hears, and it is recorded.
